_note: Curated semiotic-code blocks for the geology globe, keyed by need. These are HAND-CODED (Michael's monthly coding exercise) and persist between rebuilds — build_geology.py merges them into GEO as needs[].code. Data fields (counts, clusters) regenerate from corpus.json every build; THESE do not. The per-code `status` (residual/dominant/emergent) is what the Code Velocity card diffs month-over-month. Add a need key here when a theme gets coded. Copyright rule: img values are hotlinks to publishers' own servers, never stored locally.

Certified Human.name: The Provenance Ledger
Certified Human.one: Documentation is the aesthetic: credits, captions, materials, dimensions, and consent lines do the certifying.

all.name: The Provenance Ledger
all.one: Documentation is the aesthetic: credits, captions, materials, dimensions, and consent lines do the certifying.

all.name: Countable Labor
all.one: Authentication by enumeration: the stitch macro, the field of ten thousand units, the headline that counts the years.

all.name: The Unretouched Witness
all.one: Imperfect human presence as the logo: life-marked faces, mature casting, hard flash, clutter left in frame.

all.name: Slop, Repainted Slow
all.one: Disposable detritus, screenshots, memes, shipping cartons, lovingly re-rendered in slow media with its artifacts preserved.

all.name: The Analog Sanctuary
all.one: Warm-lit rooms where slow media is practiced together: the listening bar, the record shop, the reading cafe, the archive as altar.

Naming the Machine.name: The Receipt Dump
Naming the Machine.one: The machine indicted with its own paperwork: spreadsheets, margin tables, and redacted screenshots published as the picture.

all.name: The Receipt Dump
all.one: The machine indicted with its own paperwork: spreadsheets, margin tables, and redacted screenshots published as the picture.

all.name: The Cut-and-Paste Dossier
all.one: The case against the system assembled with visible tape, torn edges, halftone scraps, and duotone clip-art.

all.name: The Rigging in Shot
all.one: Shoot the spectacle so its rigging shows: sponsor boards, press banks, LED walls, and the stage on the state's lawn.

all.name: The Icon Assembly Line
all.one: The fame machine exposed by lining up its output: one icon replicated across painting, print, merch, and cartoon.

Self-Authorship.name: Author Among the Work
Self-Authorship.one: Show the maker inside the evidence of their making: studio, worktable, gallery wall, shelf of one's own output.

all.name: Author Among the Work
all.one: Show the maker inside the evidence of their making: studio, worktable, gallery wall, shelf of one's own output.

all.name: The Self Staged as the Work
all.one: Author, director, and subject collapse into one: the body performed for the camera as the artwork itself.

all.name: Heritage Re-Signed
all.one: Take the inherited form — weave, quipu, embroidery, the label you were handed — and re-sign it in your own hand.

all.name: The Remix Self
all.one: Author the self out of the feed's own materials: glitter, filters, affirmations, screenshots, jelly-translucent pop shards.

all.name: Against the Algorithm
all.one: The unrepeatable hand and voice, asserted against a machine that can only average: authorship as the one thing that can't be generated.

Settling Accounts.name: Restaged Verdict
Settling Accounts.one: Re-enact the contested past beat for beat and let the fidelity read as the ruling.

all.name: Restaged Verdict
all.one: Re-enact the contested past beat for beat and let the fidelity read as the ruling.

all.name: Canon Corrected
all.one: Photograph the institution admitting the exclusion: the rehang, the retrospective at 93, the toppled bronze laid out as evidence.

all.name: Stitched Testimony
all.one: Sew the accusation into the cloth: humble materials carrying the record the archive refused to keep.

all.name: Inheritance Reactivated
all.one: Hold the inheritance by using it: the family archive reprinted warm, the ancestral technique re-run on today's machines.

Appetite.name: The Defiant Feast
Appetite.one: Eat like it's an argument: saturated, messy, communal, unashamed — appetite painted back into the picture.

all.name: The Defiant Feast
all.one: Eat like it's an argument: saturated, messy, communal, unashamed — appetite painted back into the picture.

all.name: Prescription Pleasure
all.one: The diagnosis is the aperitif: appetite managed, and the management aestheticized as pleasure.

all.name: The Aphrodisiac Table
all.one: Set the table like a flirtation: food as sensual object, the meal as the seduction, the mess as the proof.

all.name: Flesh as Form
all.one: The body that ate is the design object: flesh draped, padded, exhibited — and at the far edge, made grotesque.

all.name: Dark Cornucopia
all.one: Paint the feast at midnight: abundance on black, decay jewelled, the bubble about to burst.

all.name: Toy Hunger
all.one: Give the appetite a toy: collection, game, and play-staged design as the permission structure for adult indulgence.
